Subject: Vendor onboarding: Crestline Systems - documents attached

Hi Irene and Redwood team,

Hope you’re well. We’re ready to be onboarded as a supplier so we can receive POs and payments from Redwood. To help your vendor master team, I’ve attached our W-9 (Crestline_W9.pdf) and a bank verification letter (crestline_bank_letter.pdf).

Please confirm which legal name you will use for the vendor record (we operate as Crestline Systems, Inc. — DBA Crestline Solutions), and whether you need a separate remit address. Also confirm the payment terms you expect to apply (net30, net45, etc.) and the PO contact we should reference on invoices.

For your records:
- Legal name: Crestline Systems, Inc.
- DBA: Crestline Solutions
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Primary remit address: 1248 Harbor Drive, Suite 300, San Diego, CA 92101

If there are additional fields in your intake form (beneficial owners, tax withholding, currency), let me know and I’ll supply them.

Thanks,
Anna Perez
Senior Procurement Manager
Crestline Systems
anna.perez@crestline.com | +1 (619) 555-0199

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Crestline Systems - documents attached

Hi Anna — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. We’ll start the vendor setup but need a couple of confirmations before creation:

1) Legal entity to use in our master record: please confirm whether we should list "Crestline Systems, Inc." or the DBA "Crestline Solutions" as the official vendor name. Our AP prefers the legal entity but is fine storing the DBA in an alias field.
2) Please complete the attached vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form.xlsx) and return it; it captures remit and invoice routing, owner names, and tax questions.
3) Confirm the bank details to be used for ACH vs wire. If you prefer, a masked ABA/account in the bank letter is okay but AP will need the full account when executing enrollment.
4) Any TIN mismatch or special withholding instructions?

Next steps: once we receive the filled intake form and confirm EIN matches the W-9, I’ll create the vendor record and loop in Marcus from Finance to set payment terms. Target: add to vendor registry and queue for our next pay cycle.

I’ve attached our intake form for convenience.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Contracts Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
(irene.choi@redwoodinference.com)
